_about: Swipe-survey concept cards (taste.py). Cards ask 'Would you eat this?' about a generic dish or a way of eating, never a store product, so a swipe measures taste rather than brand, packaging or price. 'dish' cards are hand-tagged with taste.py's labels (meal, flavor list, cuisine, protein list) plus rough per-serving kcal and protein/carbs/fat grams, and only count on the flavor, cuisine, protein, meal, macros, density and diet groups: they say nothing about format, so a 'yes' to tacos reaches fresh and frozen tacos alike. 'format' cards only count on format and processing and are dealt in file order (biggest share of the catalog first), so a 'no' to frozen meals reaches frozen items of every cuisine. 'image' is null or {url, page, author, license, license_url, source}; null falls back to the styled placeholder (emoji + cuisine tint).
